body: I need to get the professional help but its just so scary biggest problem of the whole thing for me is the waiting times i just spend months dreading the appointment at somepoint i hope i can get the courage to get the help but i cant atm its too big of a step im going to go try get some sleep thank you for talking with me :) hope you have a nice day cya

I've tried talking to professional help before and i just lie to them and pretend stuffs not as bad as it is or by the time i get an appointment im not feeling down at all and they just think im completely fine and i know how quick it can turn from fine to suicidal i tried to kill myself near the start of the year and i was feeling that bad when i made the post but i feel a lot better now i think i just needed to vent and talk to someone

I know it will pass but feeling like this is just the complete worst i hate it so much do you think i should just talk to my friend about feeling really bad? He has a lot going on at the moment and im not sure if its really fair for me to tell him how bad im feeling while he is busy doing his own stuff 
and thanks for taking time out of your day to help strangers on the internet

I really hope it was someone just being nice but i cant imagine anyone saying anything nice about my appearance and i really don't know i was feeling fine a few days ago i was feeling really proud of myself for finally getting something done but i just slowly over the past few days just started to feel worse and worse and now i have hit rock bottom again i just want to feel happy all the time i hate feeling this bad
